en.text: In Hong Kong, salaries tax is normally paid by two instalments and the tax payment can be made through the post. This practice agrees with the ______ principle of taxation.

zh.text: 在本港，薪俸稅通常分兩期繳交，而稅款可以通過郵寄方式繳付。這種做法符合徵稅的 ______ 原則。
香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 46 題

en.text: A Japan electronics firm produces and sells its products in Hong Kong. Therefore, it has to pay profits tax to the Hong Kong government. Hong Kong is applying the

zh.text: 某日本電子廠在香港生產及銷售其產品，故須向香港政府繳交利得稅。香港奉行什麼徵稅原則？
香港中學會考 1996 卷二 第 40 題

en.text: The payment of salaries tax and profits tax can be made by the Payment by Phone Service (PPS) by which taxpayers can transfer money from their bank accounts to the government. This practice satisfies the ________ principle of taxation.

zh.text: 納稅人可透過繳費聆服務將金錢由自己的銀行戶口轉往政府的戶口，用來繳付薪俸稅和利得稅。這種做法符合賦稅的 __________ 原則。
香港中學會考 2000 卷二 第 40 題

en.text: Suppose the government of an economy announces that the people will have to pay a general sales tax of 2% of the selling price when they purchase any goods and services. The government also launches a series of programmes to make sure that the public understands the new tax.

zh.text: 假設某經濟的政府宣佈每當國民購買貨品或服務時，他們便須繳付一項普及銷售稅，而稅率是售價的 2%。該政府同時推行一系列推廣項目，以確保公明瞭該新稅項。

en.text: Which of the following taxation principles is illustrated by the above measures of the government?

zh.text: 上述政府措施說明了下列哪一項賦稅原則？
香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 39 題

en.text: In Hong Kong, citizens are allowed to make their tax payments through the Internet. This practice is in line with the ______ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith.

zh.text: 香港政府容許市民透過互聯網繳交稅款。該措施符合亞當史密斯提出的______賦稅原則。
香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 41 題

en.text: The Inland Revenue Department will inform every salaries tax payer of the amount of tax payable either by mail or by the etax account. This practice is in line with the ________ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith.

zh.text: 稅務局會透過郵件或稅務易戶口通知每位薪俸稅納稅人應付的稅款總額。這項安排符合亞當史密夫所提出的 ______ 賦稅原則。
香港中學文憑考試 練習卷 卷一 第 37 題

en.text: In July 2009, the government introduced an environmental levy of 50 cents on each plastic shopping bag at the retail level, with the first phase covering chain or large supermarkets, convenience stores and personal health and beauty product stores. Small shops are exempted in the first phase. Customers can pay the levy, with the original amount of purchase of goods, by credit card, Easy Pay System (EPS) or cash.

zh.text: 在二零零九年七月，政府在零售層面開徵每個塑膠購物袋5角的環保費，首階段範圍包括連鎖或大型超市、便利店及個人護理和美容產品店。在首階段小商戶獲得豁免。顧客可使用信用卡、易辦事（EPS）或現金一併支付原初購物金額和環保費。

en.text: The collection of the above environmental levy is
in line with the ______ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith.

zh.text: 徵收上述的環保費最不符合亞當史密所提出的 ________ 賦稅原則。
香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 35 題

en.text: The following is an extract of the mission of the Inland Revenue Department.

zh.text: 以下為稅務局使命的撮要。

en.text: enabling staff to acquire the necessary knowledge, skills and attitude so that they can contribute their best to the achievement of our vision

zh.text: 以有效率及有成本效益的方法收取稅款
協助員工具備應有的知識、技巧和態度，從而竭盡所能，實踐我們的抱負

en.text: The above mission is in line with the ______________ principle of taxation put forward by Adam Smith.

zh.text: 上述使命符合亞當史密夫所提出的徵稅________原則。
香港中學文憑考試 2020 卷一 第 39 題
